rawUserRequest: 目标是第二阶段性能优化：在不减少验证范围、不降低覆盖率、不绕过门禁、不牺牲 Outcome 和失败证据的前提下，缩短开发者获得可信反馈的等待时间。以 HCI 可感知等待时间验收；建立可比较的五次同 SHA Hosted 基线与候选测量，拆分 project-test 并行 shard，优化 immutable lifecycle fixture，消除重复验证，持续输出进度，增加防测试弱化机器门；只有五次可比较 Hosted 测量全部达到量化目标才允许绿色 Outcome。不得修改或重建 v0.5.50，不得使用 SKIP_QUALITY。用户授权完成全部 Work Item、记录必要确认并写入 Contract。

declaredIntent.summary: Reduce trustworthy developer feedback latency by optimizing the quality critical path while preserving complete, source-bound, fail-closed verification evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: Parallel shards, coverage aggregation, fixture caching, and hosted evidence can silently omit tests or misreport results unless every missing, mismatched, cancelled, or failed artifact closes fail-closed.

acceptance: Baseline and candidate samples are strictly separate; each set contains at least five sequential successful hosted_measurement runs at one exact source SHA/tree, identical workflow/runner image/OS/Python class, and reports sample count plus nearest-rank p50/p95.

Quality summaries record source commit/tree digest, runner image/OS/Python, workflow/run/attempt, gate start/end/wall time, pytest collection/pass/fail/skip, coverage, top 25 slow tests, CPU concurrency, cache hit/miss, and performance statistics.

quality-fast has p95 <=60 seconds and deterministic lint/format/scope/Status/Contract failures become visible within 30 seconds; quality execution emits current gate, elapsed time, completion count, last progress, and evidence path at least every 30 seconds.

Hosted project-test aggregate has p50 <=420 seconds and p95 <=480 seconds, with p95 at least 25% lower than 655 seconds; template-smoke total p95 is <=480 seconds with project-test aggregate p95 <=420 seconds reserved to leave non-test overhead budget.

Hosted project-test uses deterministic historical-duration-balanced core/governance/installer/lifecycle/release shards on independent runners, each with isolated JUnit, coverage, timing, and mutable state; aggregate merges coverage and fails closed on any missing, skipped, cancelled, failed, wrong-SHA, or unowned shard artifact.

The local serial project-test diagnostic entrypoint remains available and is equivalent to the complete manifest; immutable tree-digest fixtures and isolated copies preserve lifecycle, installer, rollback, dirty-worktree, permissions, line-ending, and symlink failure paths.

Machine checks reject node-set deletion/rename/unowned placement, unexpected skip/xfail growth, coverage-source loss, aggregate shard omissions, and mutations deleting a shard/JUnit/coverage/receipt field or using a wrong shard SHA.

No test count is reduced, coverage is >=85.10%, no unexplained skip/xfail/quarantine is added, every failure/timeout/cancellation writes red Outcome, JUnit, gate log, and recovery condition, and successful complete evidence writes green Outcome.

The named local commands pass: make quality-fast, make quality-full, make quality-release, make check-quality-architecture, make check-instruction-traceability, make check-ai-status-consistency, and make ai-prepare-hosted-verification-snapshot.
Before ai-finish, the active Summary contains the raw five-or-more candidate measurements, source-bound artifacts, comparability decisions, percentile calculations, and a truthful Outcome color.
The Work Item follows the governed ai-finish, PR, required Hosted checks, merge, ai-close-work-item, and local/remote branch-cleanup lifecycle without changing v0.5.50 artifacts.
guidelines: Never trade test-set completeness, coverage, security, release gates, Outcome visibility, or failure evidence for speed.
Use source-tree-digest-bound immutable inputs and per-test/per-shard isolated mutable outputs.
Treat missing, skipped, cancelled, stale, malformed, mismatched-SHA, or cache-only evidence as failure, not as success.
Keep local serial diagnostics semantically equivalent to Hosted sharding and document public Make targets and receipt schemas in English, Chinese, and Japanese.
Only report green after all five comparable candidate Hosted measurements meet every quantitative target.

intent.problem: The current hosted project-test consumes roughly 637–642 seconds and the quality/PR path roughly 630–655 seconds. Failures may remain poorly localized while expensive lifecycle and installer setup repeat, causing developers to wait too long for trustworthy feedback.
constraints: Retain the full test set, coverage >=85.10%, all security/release/governance gates, red/green Outcome behavior, JUnit, logs, recovery instructions, and fail-closed aggregate semantics.
Do not change or rebuild v0.5.50, use SKIP_QUALITY, use a single run as proof, or treat cache presence as validation.
Collect baseline and candidate statistics only from their own five or more sequential, same-SHA/tree, same runner-class hosted_measurement samples; failures/cancellations invalidate green acceptance.
intent.rationale: The practical way to reduce human waiting is to make fast deterministic failures immediately visible, run independent test groups on isolated Hosted runners, eliminate repeatable setup through immutable fixtures, and retain enough source-bound evidence to prove no verification was weakened.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A project-test shard, JUnit, coverage file, receipt field, or aggregate member is missing, skipped, cancelled, failed, stale, or bound to a different SHA.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Aggregate fails closed, preserves red Outcome/JUnit/gate log/recovery evidence, and cannot publish a success receipt.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add focused mutation regressions for each missing/mismatched artifact and run workflow/aggregate tests plus a Hosted candidate measurement.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A shard plan deletes, renames, or leaves pytest/shell/E2E test entries unowned, or increases skip/xfail/quarantine.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Manifest comparison rejects the result before aggregate success and preserves the local serial equivalence entrypoint.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add deterministic manifest and weakening regression tests, then run project-test and quality-full.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Parallel lifecycle or installer tests share mutable Git, environment, lock, Status, Outcome, or target state.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Each test starts from a tree-digest-bound immutable fixture and an isolated copy; historical failure paths remain executed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add isolation and cache-key regressions, run focused lifecycle/installer tests, then run local quality and Hosted shards.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A deterministic quality gate fails, times out, or is cancelled during local or Hosted execution.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The failure name appears within 30 seconds; every 30 seconds carries current progress; red Outcome and recoverable artifacts remain available.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add runner/progress failure and timeout tests; inspect local logs and Hosted artifacts from candidate measurements.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Five comparable Hosted candidate samples do not meet a threshold or are incomparable.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Summary records factual samples and a yellow/red Outcome; no green completion claim is emitted.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run five sequential hosted_measurement dispatches from the snapshot-bound candidate SHA and validate statistics/comparability before ai-finish.
